# YM51: 课农轩 Kenong Xuan

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM51` · Page: `/scenes/#YM51` · Row: `research/buildings/YM51-kenong-xuan/`

## What it was

课农轩 Kenong Xuan, built in 1817 (Jiaqing) as a five-bay hall with a three-bay annex on the sites of 皆春阁, 稻凉楼, 涉趣楼 and 湛虚书屋 of 北远山村 (E1756, S361). Not in S05 (1774+), as expected. Parts of the village survived 1860 under guard (E1756). 刘敦桢's 1933 list of 17 buildings left after 1860 includes 课农轩 (E0451, S337).

From the inventory row: **built** 1816, from 北远山村's 皆春阁 range; **destroyed** survived 1860 per 1873 survey (S06); survived 1860; later loss (S06, S01, S337, S360).
